ai_label: AI-generated instrumental music (rule-based symbolic composition rendered with sampled instruments)

request.prompt: calm ambient meditation that slowly builds

stems.name: drums
stems.production: symbolic MIDI -> fluidsynth render + numpy FX

stems.name: bass
stems.production: symbolic MIDI -> fluidsynth render + numpy FX

stems.name: harmony
stems.production: symbolic MIDI -> fluidsynth render + numpy FX

stems.name: melody
stems.production: symbolic MIDI -> fluidsynth render + numpy FX

mix_formula: mix = sum(stems[i].gain * stems[i]) (stems stored post master gain and limiter)

components.name: FluidR3_GM SoundFont
components.commercial_use: Yes. MIT: 'to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell'. Rendered audio is our output, not a copy of the SoundFont.

components.name: FluidSynth
components.commercial_use: Yes. Invoked as an unmodified separate program (subprocess); no linking. Output audio carries no licence obligation.

components.name: FFmpeg (Debian build incl. libmp3lame)
components.commercial_use: Yes. Invoked as an unmodified separate program (subprocess); GPL obligations apply to redistribution of the binary (source offer from Debian), not to the audio it produces.
components.role: mp3 encode, narration decode, independent loudness check

components.name: musicengine (this repository)
components.commercial_use: Yes. Composition rules, presets and DSP written for this project; no trained music model, no copied songs.
components.role: prompt interpretation, composition, numpy synth/FX, mixing, QA

components.name: langdetect
components.licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE file; PyPI metadata field says MIT, classifier says Apache)

components.name: psycopg / psycopg-pool
components.commercial_use: Yes. Used unmodified as an installed library.

components.name: boto3 / httpx / structlog / PyYAML / python-multipart
components.licence: Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause / MIT OR Apache-2.0 / MIT / Apache-2.0
components.role: storage client, HTTP client, logging, config, uploads

components.name: MinIO server
components.commercial_use: Used unmodified as a separate network service for the demo. For production, point S3_* at a non-AGPL S3 backend (AWS S3, R2, etc.); no code change needed.
